quote: IDB Invest has structured and purchased its first project bond in the U.S. market to provide $219 million worth of financing to Rutas del Este S.A. for the design and construction of national roads 2 and 7 in Paraguay. Rutas del Este is a consortium comprised of companies Sacyr Concesiones and Ocho A. … The project has a total cost of approximately $530 million and is the first public-private partnership (PPP) contract signed within the framework of Paraguay's PPP Law … The concession was granted in 2016 and consists of the extension and improvement of 140km of road.
note: Opened IDB Invest 12 Jan 2022 (Rutas 2 y 7 Paraguay PPP).
